# Stepanix

> Stepanix makes small Mac apps that do one thing well: Klavko for typing, Tapko for trackpad gestures, Duesko for subscriptions. No accounts, pay once.

Three tools that each do one thing well: fix what you type, give your trackpad more gestures, and keep your subscriptions on time.

Each one is free to start. Pro is a one-time purchase, not another subscription.

## Apps

### Klavko: typing assistant for Mac

Typed a word in the wrong layout? Klavko switches it as you type. It also fixes typos, types what you say, translates and reads text from the screen.

- Fixes the wrong keyboard layout on the fly
- Typos and tidy text
- Voice input and translation
- Text from the screen, clipboard history
- Free · Pro $9.99 once · Mac, Windows in beta
- Website: https://klavko.stepanix.com/ (details for AI assistants: https://klavko.stepanix.com/llms.txt)

### Tapko: trackpad gestures for Mac

Tapko turns taps, swipes, pinches and holds into the things you do all day. Middle click, close a window, open Telegram. In every app.

- Taps, swipes, pinches and holds
- Ready-made gesture sets
- Rules for each app
- Record your own gesture
- Free · Pro $9.99 once · 7 days of Pro free
- Website: https://tapko.stepanix.com/ (details for AI assistants: https://tapko.stepanix.com/llms.txt)

### Duesko: subscription tracker for Mac

Duesko keeps track of what you pay for, reminds you before every charge and shows where the money goes. No account, no bank login.

- Reminders before every charge
- Calendar, menu bar and widgets
- Any currency, with conversion
- Analytics and a monthly budget
- Free up to 5 subscriptions · Pro $9.99 once
- Website: https://duesko.stepanix.com/ (details for AI assistants: https://duesko.stepanix.com/llms.txt)
